newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cardoso to study changes in Vale sale model.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cardoso to study changes in Vale sale model.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso agreed to study a proposal to offer to the public more shares of soon-to-be-privatized mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce, Folha de Sao Paulo daily said.

The proposal, backed by Liberal Front Party (PFL) senator Antonio Carlos Magalhaes, was submitted to Cardoso on Sunday by Lower House president and senator's son Luis Eduardo Magalhaes, the daily said.

Under Vale's sell-off plan, an initial sale of 40-45 percent block of voting shares in the company would begin in February. The remainder would be offered to employees, and domestic and foreign investors in a second and third phases.
According to Folha, Luis Eduardo Magalhaes said this new sale model would ease political opposition to the company's privatization.
